description: This PHP source file defines the SecurityGroup class, extending SecurityGroup_sugar, with methods for managing security groups, including retrieval, inheritance, and relationship handling within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: SecurityGroup
classes.description: Represents a security group with methods for managing group memberships, inheritance, and relationships within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getGroupWhere
methods.description: Returns SQL WHERE clause for retrieving records a user has group rights to, considering security group membership.

methods.name: getGroupUsersWhere
methods.description: Returns SQL WHERE clause for retrieving users in the same security group as a given user.

methods.name: getGroupJoin
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN clause for including security group data in record queries.

methods.name: getGroupUsersJoin
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN clause for including users in the same security group.

methods.name: groupHasAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific record and action within a module based on security groups.

methods.name: inherit
methods.description: Handles inheritance of security groups for a given record, including default, creator, assigned, and parent inheritance.

methods.name: assign_default_groups
methods.description: Assigns default security groups to a new record based on module configuration.

methods.name: inherit_creator
methods.description: Inherits security groups from the creator of a record.

methods.name: inherit_assigned
methods.description: Inherits security groups from the assigned user.

methods.name: inherit_parent
methods.description: Inherits security groups from a parent record or related entity.

methods.name: inherit_parentQuery
methods.description: Executes SQL to inherit security groups from a parent entity.

methods.name: inheritOne
methods.description: Inherits security group if user belongs to exactly one group.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the number of inheritable security groups a user belongs to.

methods.name: retrieveDefaultGroups
methods.description: Retrieves default security groups configured for the system.

methods.name: saveDefaultGroup
methods.description: Saves a default security group for a module.

methods.name: removeDefaultGroup
methods.description: Removes a default security group configuration.

methods.name: getSecurityModules
methods.description: Returns modules that are tied to security groups, excluding blacklisted modules.

methods.name: getLinkName
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship link name between modules for security group relationships.

methods.name: addGroupToRecord
methods.description: Associates a security group with a specific record.

methods.name: removeGroupFromRecord
methods.description: Removes association of a security group from a record.

methods.name: getUserSecurityGroups
methods.description: Returns all security groups a user belongs to.

methods.name: getAllSecurityGroups
methods.description: Returns all security groups in the system.

methods.name: getMembers
methods.description: Returns active users who are members of this security group.

methods.name: getPrimaryGroupID
methods.description: Returns the primary security group ID for the current user.

methods.name: getParentGroups
methods.description: Retrieves parent security groups for a record, typically for display or inheritance.

methods.name: getRecordGroups
methods.description: Retrieves security groups associated with a specific record.

methods.name: getParentBean
methods.description: Fetches a bean object for a parent record given its ID and type.
